نستفحل (form X)
# نَسْتَفْحِلُ (nastafḥilu) /nas.taf.ħi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# نَسْتَفْحِلَ (nastafḥila) /nas.taf.ħi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# نَسْتَفْحِلْ (nastafḥil) /nas.taf.ħil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
